test_item_verbatim: Rear Camera display image shall remain displayed until driver presses the softkey to disable it.

tcs.tc_title: softkey disable, read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is no longer displayed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The rear view camera image is displayed in Manual Display Mode
4. The vehicle speed is below 8 mph
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "X" on the rear view camera image
2. Read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is no longer displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The rear view camera image is closed
2. No camera image is displayed and the previous screen is shown again
tcs.test_item:
Rear Camera display image shall remain displayed until driver presses the softkey to disable it.

(softkey disable, read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is no longer displayed)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 SYS-RA-CAM-077（ObjectID 4781642）之「影像持續顯示直至駕駛按軟鍵關閉」。錨取 Rear Camera 節（R-CAM12）；Cargo/CHMSL 節之逐字近似句 SYS-RA-CAM-064 不作錨。車速低於 8 mph 為 SYS-RA-CAM-079 所定之持續前提，使本列只驗軟鍵關閉一支。與 NR1L-RVC-006 之差別：後者錨於 VF551_V2-549（RVC_ImageDefeat.Req），本列錨於 CFTS092 之持續顯示條文。
